title: Inter's only match before Parma is behind closed doors
caption:
Inter's only match before Parma is on Saturday — and nobody can watch it. Per Inter.it, the Lumezzane friendly at Appiano Gentile kicks off 5:00 AM ET / 11:00 CEST behind closed doors, with no broadcast announced. Per Gazzetta dello Sport, Marcus Thuram is the only striker training there this week.
